body.en: An academic article states that after the new acting president could not continue as candidate, urgent meetings and backroom deals made Jorge Meléndez, brother of Carlos, the family's candidate. It adds that his mandate ended in early 1923, when Alfonso Quiñónez Molina was vice president.

body.zh-Hant: 他延續兄長的現代化方案，開設首座機場、宣布掃除文盲運動，並設立貨幣委員會。他也因更常動用紅色聯盟而被記住。該組織是旨在阻撓勞工組織的隱秘準軍事團體。其姻兄弟阿方索·奎諾尼斯·莫利納於1923至1927年任總統。
body.en: He continued his brother's modernization program by opening the first airport, announcing a campaign to eradicate illiteracy and creating a monetary commission. He is also remembered for his increased use of the Red League. It was a shadowy paramilitary group designed to thwart labor organization. His brother-in-law Alfonso Quiñónez Molina was president from 1923 to 1927.

body.zh-Hant: 凱利奧（Kyösti Kallio）1873年4月10日出生，是一位農民。他自1904年起擔任芬蘭議會議員，1908年與人共同創立農民聯盟（Agrarförbundet），即今日的中央黨；這個黨在很大程度上靠他的功勞成為芬蘭最主要的資產階級政黨。早年在語言爭議中，他支持芬蘭語化的主張。
body.en: Kyösti Kallio was born on 10 April 1873 and was a farmer. He sat in the Finnish legislature from 1904, and in 1908 he co-founded the Agrarförbundet (Agrarian League), today's Centre Party, which largely thanks to him became Finland's dominant bourgeois party. In the earlier language dispute he had supported the Finnish-language movement.

i høj grad hans fortjeneste, at det blev Finlands dominerende borgerlige parti
tidligere i sprogstriden havde støttet finskhedsbestræbelserne

heading.en: Minister of Agriculture and land reform

body.zh-Hant: 凱利奧在1919至1920年、1921至1922年兩度擔任農業部長。他透過徵收與分割土地，讓農村無地人口取得土地。這項改革在1917年芬蘭脫離俄國後分數個階段推行，1922年以「凱利奧法」（Lex Kallio）達到高峰。
body.en: Kallio served as minister of agriculture in 1919-1920 and 1921-1922. Through expropriation and parcelling of land he obtained land for the landless part of the rural population. The reform was carried out in several stages after Finland's liberation from Russia in 1917 and peaked with the so-called Lex Kallio in 1922.

citations.quote: Som landbrugsminister 1919-20 og 1921-22

gjennomført i flere etapper etter Finlands frigjøring fra Russland i 1917
som nådde sitt høydepunkt med den såkalte Lex Kallio i 1922

body.zh-Hant: 凱利奧共四度出任總理：1922至1924年、1925至1926年、1929至1930年與1936至1937年，組成的是非社會主義的聯合政府。前三任期間，他致力於內戰後的和解，因此在右翼的拉普阿運動（Lappobevægelsen）眼中不受歡迎。他在1904至1937年間任國會議員，1917年以前在邦議會（Landdagen），其後在國會（Riksdagen）。
body.en: Kallio was prime minister four times: 1922-1924, 1925-1926, 1929-1930 and 1936-1937, leading non-socialist coalition governments. During the first three terms he worked for reconciliation after the Finnish Civil War, which made him unpopular with the right-wing Lappo movement. He was a member of parliament from 1904 to 1937, in the Diet (Landdagen) until 1917 and in the Riksdag afterwards.

body.zh-Hant: 1937年，凱利奧在社會民主黨的支持下當選芬蘭總統，第一個所謂的紅綠政府因而得以組成。他以國家元首身分推行和解政策，使社會民主黨時隔十年重新入閣。1939至1940年的冬季戰爭是他任內最大的任務：開戰前他積極爭取國外支持，戰時的穩定態度使他成為芬蘭人民團結的象徵。戰爭的重壓損害了他的健康，他於1940年11月退下職位，不久後去世；他去世當天，繼任者里斯托·呂提接任其職位。
body.en: In 1937 Kallio was elected president of Finland with Social Democratic support, which allowed the first so-called red-green government to be formed. As head of state he pursued a policy of reconciliation that brought the Social Democrats back into government after ten years. His greatest task as president was the Winter War of 1939-1940: before it he worked energetically to win support abroad, and his steady attitude during the war made him a unifying figure. The strain damaged his health; he stepped down in November 1940 and died soon after, on the same day his successor Risto Ryti took over his post.

body.zh-Hant: 弗朗茨·約瑟夫二世1906年8月16日生於施泰爾馬克的弗勞恩塔爾城堡。1925至1929年他在維也納的土地文化大學（Hochschule für Bodenkultur）修讀林業，1929年取得林業工程文憑。1923年，他的父親與叔父先後放棄繼承權（2月26日與3月1日），使他升為親王家族繼承順位的第二位。
body.en: Franz Josef II was born on 16 August 1906 at Schloss Frauenthal in Styria. From 1925 to 1929 he studied forestry at the Hochschule für Bodenkultur in Vienna and took his diploma in forestry engineering in 1929. After his father and his uncle renounced the succession in 1923 (on 26 February and 1 March), he moved to second place in the line of succession.

heading.en: Representing the prince and family affairs

body.zh-Hant: 1927年，他代表約翰二世親王視察萊茵河決堤在列支敦士登造成的災損。1929年約翰二世去世後，他接手管理屬於長子繼承財產的奧地利與捷克斯洛伐克領地。1930年他替親王家族取得列支敦士登銀行（Bank in Liechtenstein）的多數股權。同年4月17日，弗朗茨一世親王「視情況」委託他代理自己，此後這位繼承人多次以親王代表的身分前往列支敦士登。
body.en: In 1927 he inspected, as representative of Prince Johann II, the damage caused in Liechtenstein by the Rhine flood. After the death of Johann II in 1929 he took over the administration of the Austrian and Czechoslovak estates held in entail. In 1930 he acquired the majority of the shares of the Bank in Liechtenstein for the princely house. On 17 April 1930 Prince Franz I entrusted him with representing him "on occasion", and the heir then travelled repeatedly to Liechtenstein as the prince's representative.

body.zh-Hant: 1938年3月13日奧地利併入納粹德國，列支敦士登因而多了一個新而危險的鄰國。同年3月，在他的影響下，進步市民黨與愛國聯盟同意由多數制改為比例代表制，並組成聯合政府。3月30日，85歲的弗朗茨一世把親王的政府事務交給他（「攝政親王」）。7月25日弗朗茨一世去世，他成為在位親王，並成為第一位住在列支敦士登的親王。1939年5月29日（聖靈降臨節星期一）在瓦杜茲城堡前舉行對新親王的效忠典禮。
body.en: On 13 March 1938 Austria was annexed by National Socialist Germany, which gave Liechtenstein a new and dangerous neighbour. In March 1938, under his influence, the Progressive Citizens' Party and the Patriotic Union agreed to move from a majority to a proportional electoral system and to form a coalition government. On 30 March 1938 the 85-year-old Prince Franz I handed him the princely government business ("Prinzregent"). On 25 July 1938 Franz I died and he became reigning prince, the first prince to take up residence in Liechtenstein. The homage to the new prince took place on Whit Monday, 29 May 1939, at Vaduz Castle.

body.zh-Hant: 1939年9月1日爆發的第二次世界大戰給國家帶來新的政治與經濟問題，親王與政府的任務是維持中立、鞏固國家獨立。1940年3月25日（復活節星期一），他在沙恩（Schaan）杜克斯的「安慰聖母」小教堂，把國土與人民奉獻給聖母。1943年他應政府請求，把邦議會任期無限期延長，以免選戰給列支敦士登的納粹分子一個舞台。1944年他違反邦議會與政府的意願，下令重開1933年關閉的伯恩公使館。1945年，霍普（Josef Hoop）政府在他的壓力下辭職。
body.en: The Second World War, which broke out on 1 September 1939, brought new political and economic problems; the task for the prince and the government was to keep the country neutral and consolidate its independence. On Easter Monday, 25 March 1940, he consecrated the country and its people to the Virgin Mary in the chapel Maria zum Trost at Dux in Schaan. In 1943, at the government's request, he extended the Landtag's mandate indefinitely to prevent an election campaign that would have given Liechtenstein's National Socialists a platform. In 1944, against the will of the Landtag and the government, he ordered the reopening of the legation in Bern, closed in 1933. In 1945 the Josef Hoop government resigned under pressure from him.
